name: MOO_OPTY_ACCESS
description: Table containing denormed Opportunity Resources and Opportunity Territories. This Denormed table is used in defining the security on Opportunity.

columns.name: OPTY_ID
columns.description: Opportunity Id of the referenced Opportunity

columns.name: TYPE_CODE
columns.description: Type of the Group - 'RESOURCE'  OR ' TERRITORY'.

columns.name: OPTY_RESOURCE_ID
columns.description: ID for Opportunity Sales Team member.

columns.name: REVN_TERR_ID
columns.description: ID for Opportunity Summary Revenue Line Territory Association.

columns.name: ACCESS_LEVEL_CODE
columns.description: Access level determines the type of access granted to the manager/admin of the organizations in the hierarchy.

columns.name: OPTY_EFFECTIVE_DATE
columns.description: Estimated close date for this opportunity - defaulted from opportunity's close date.

columns.name: OPTY_STATUS_CD
columns.description: Status code of this opportunity - defaulted  from opportunity's status code.

columns.name: CREATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who created the row.

columns.name: CREATION_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the creation of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the last update of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_LOGIN
columns.description: Who column: indicates the session login associated to the user who last updated the row.
